title: 3 houses — names & drinks (demonstrates a genuine dead rule)

clues.source: Alice is in the first house.
Bob is somewhere to the left of Carol.
The person in the first house drinks tea.
The person in the third house drinks milk.
Alice is somewhere to the left of Carol.

verification: encoded_constraints_only; hand-authored IR run through the real solver (puzzlelab.zebra.solve, mode=symbolic_only), not LLM-parsed -- built specifically because the demo pool had no genuine example of a redundant clue; clue 5 ("Alice is somewhere to the left of Carol") is provably implied by clues 1+2 together (Alice fixed at house 1, Bob left of Carol -- since Alice already holds the leftmost position, she is trivially left of Carol too), verified both by the real solver and independently by brute-force enumeration of every possible assignment.
